description: This Java class represents a USB device supporting the adb protocol, managing USB endpoints, sockets, and communication threads.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device supporting adb protocol, managing communication, sockets, and threading.

classes.name: WaiterThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread to handle asynchronous USB message reading and dispatching.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the device.

methods.name: getOutRequest
methods.description: Retrieves an OUT UsbRequest from the pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: releaseOutRequest
methods.description: Returns an OUT UsbRequest to the pool.

methods.name: getInRequest
methods.description: Retrieves an IN UsbRequest from the pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the waiter thread and initiates connection.

methods.name: openSocket
methods.description: Opens a new AdbSocket to a specified destination.

methods.name: getSocket
methods.description: Retrieves a socket by its ID.

methods.name: socketClosed
methods.description: Removes a socket from the active sockets list.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Sends a connect command to the device.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the waiter thread to stop.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches received messages to appropriate handlers or sockets.
